demos.title: From Forest to Focus Grove
demos.scope: Forest store screenshots compared with genuine generated APK footage and captures. No original Forest runtime equivalence is claimed. The one-minute timer sequence is shown at 5x; other scenes use real-time footage or still captures. Sounds, statistics and streaks overlap with Forest.

scenes.heading: Keep the core experience
points: Plant a tree, focus, and collect it when the session completes.
Preserve the circular growth scene and green visual direction.
scenes.note: Forest is a store reference; the generated artwork is simpler.

scenes.heading: Watch a real tree grow
points: Actual APK: a real one-minute session.
The tree grows with elapsed time; completion adds one tree.
Ambient sound is shared functionality, not a new Forest feature.
scenes.note: Timer footage condensed to 5x. No device-clock manipulation.

scenes.heading: Focus on a named study task
points: Adapt Focus To-Do: create, select, edit and complete study tasks.
Keep focus minutes linked to the selected task.
A custom daily minute target ties the workflow together.
scenes.note: Task-list integration is the adaptation; streaks already exist in Forest.

scenes.heading: Review time by task
points: Completed minutes feed task totals and daily progress.
Focusmeter and Loop inform the presentation.
Forest also has focus analytics: this is an adaptation, not a novelty claim.
scenes.note: Actual APK statistics capture from the recorded study session.

demos.title: From Cashew to Pocket Ledger

baseCapture.theme: Green accent selected through the original app Settings
baseCapture.data: Built-in original Cashew Preview Demo mode sample transactions

demos.scope: Both sides are genuine Android APK captures. Cashew 5.3.4+396 uses its own sample-data Preview Demo mode and a green accent selected through Settings. Pocket Ledger records are created through visible UI actions. Shared category budgets and daily allowance are not claimed as new. The proposed purchase sandbox is not a claim of global market uniqueness. Footage and still captures are edited into a comparison; datasets differ.

scenes.heading: Keep spending visible
points: Cashew is the visual foundation: rounded pastel cards and prominent money totals.
Pocket Ledger keeps a monthly overview and quick transaction entry.
scenes.note: Actual APK captures; the two apps use different example records.

scenes.heading: Make budget status clear
points: Category budgets and daily spending allowance already exist in Cashew.
Wallet informs spent / remaining / over-budget breakdowns.
Money Manager informs calendar day drill-down.
scenes.note: These reference features are refinements and foundations, not novelty claims.

scenes.heading: Try it before you buy it
points: Preview a $60 purchase against a $50 Shopping budget.
See the $10 deficit and its effect on daily allowance.
Cancel the preview: existing transactions stay unchanged.
scenes.note: A non-destructive purchase sandbox is the proposed workflow in this demo.

scenes.heading: Record only when you decide
points: Adjust the purchase to $20 and review the projected balance.
Explicitly confirm: one expense is saved, even with repeated taps.
Home totals and calendar history update together.
scenes.note: Real Android input and persisted data. Original purchase preview and recording are separate actions.
